title: Sheets & Alerts Driven by Optional Items
hints: Replace several Bools with one optional enum.
The enum's `id` must distinguish cases *and* their payloads.
Opening while `active != nil` is a replacement; `dismiss` sets it back to `nil`.
jsBridge: Driving sheets and alerts with one optional `Identifiable` item (`.sheet(item:)`) instead of many Booleans is the "make impossible states impossible" rule, the same as modelling a React modal with `selectedItem | null` rather than `isOpen` + `item`.

compass.q: React: `const [editing, setEditing] = useState<Item | null>(null)`. Same idea as `.sheet(item:)`?
Presenting a second sheet while one is open: what happens? How does one enum `ActiveSheet?` fix it?
`.sheet(isPresented:)` + separate item vs `.sheet(item:)`: which can show a sheet with a nil item?
Alerts for errors: `alert(isPresented:error:)` with a `LocalizedError?`. Sketch it.
